""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str, max_functions: Optional[int] = 35) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ if not html_content or not isinstance(html_content, str): return [] # Return an empty list if input is invalid or empty try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") except Exception as e: print(f"Error parsing HTML content: {e}") return [] # Return empty list on parsing failure functions = [] seen_names = set() # 1. Look for dt elements with sig class (Sphinx-style docs) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for block in dt_blocks: sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) signature = block.get_text(strip=True) # Extract return type if present # Enhanced return type detection return_type = "unknown" sig_return = block.find(class_="sig-return") if sig_return: return_type = sig_return.get_text(strip=True) else: # Use regex to infer return type from signature match = re.search(r"->\s*([\w\[\], ]+)", signature) if match: return_type = match.group(1).strip() else: # Fallback to infer return type from signature match = re.search(r"->\s*([\w\[\], ]+)", signature) if match: return_type = match.group(1).strip() # Find description in next dd element dd = block.find_next_sibling("dd") description = "" params_info = {} if dd: # Get main description from first paragraph # Improved description extraction for nested structures description = "" first_p = dd.find("p") if first_p: description = first_p.get_text(strip=True) else: # Check for other nested structures (e.g., div, ul) nested_div = dd.find("div") if nested_div: description = nested_div.get_text(strip=True)[:300] else: description = dd.get_text(strip=True)[:300] # Extract parameter descriptions from dl/dt/dd structure param_list = dd.find("dl", class_="field-list") if param_list: for param_dt in param_list.find_all("dt"): param_name = param_dt.get_text(strip=True) param_dd = param_dt.find_next_sibling("dd") if param_dd: params_info[param_name] = param_dd.get_text(strip=True)[:150] if not description: description = "No description found" functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature, params_info), "return_type": return_type, }) # Extract functions from headers functions += extract_from_headers(soup, seen_names) # Extract functions from code blocks functions += extract_from_code_blocks(soup, seen_names) # Apply configurable filters before returning results filtered_functions = [ func for func in functions if len(func["description"]) > 20 and not func["name"].startswith("_") # Example filters ] return filtered_functions[:max_functions] if max_functions else filtered_functions def extract_parameters(signature: str, param_descriptions: Dict[str, str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: signature: Function signature string param_descriptions: Optional dict mapping parameter names to descriptions Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ if param_descriptions is None: param_descriptions = {} params = [] # Extract parameters from signature match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string: param_parts = param_string.split(",") for part in param_parts: part = part.strip() if part: # Handle special cases like *args, **kwargs is_special = part.startswith("*") param_name = part.lstrip("*").split("=")[0].split(":")[0].strip() param_type = "unknown" default_val = None # Extract type if present if ":" in part and not is_special: type_part = part.split(":")[1].split("=")[0].strip() param_type = type_part if type_part else "unknown" # Extract default value if present if "=" in part and not is_special: default_val = part.split("=")[1].strip() # Get description from extracted parameter info param_desc = param_descriptions.get(param_name, "") params.append({ "name": param_name, "type": param_type, "default": default_val, "description": param_desc, }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("return_type") and doc["return_type"] != "unknown": output.append(f"Returns: {doc['return_type']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: param_line = f" - {param['name']}" if param.get('type') and param['type'] != 'unknown': param_line += f" ({param['type']})" if param.get('description'): param_line += f": {param['description']}" output.append(param_line) output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
